title: Evaluating the Risk Assessment: Determining Insights and Challenges of Climate Risk Prediction Using Supervised Technology
content:
ABSTRACT

In a world of expanding urbanization, which causes climate change and has adverse impacts and risks, our research introduces an intuitive and user-friendly dashboard named Climate Risk Mitigation Dashboard (CRMD) to address these challenges sustainably. Climate change is regarded as an ever-growing issue towards sustainability concerning its environmental, social, and economic aspects, driven mainly by global warming, extreme weather events, afforestation processes, deforestation tendencies, loss of biodiversity, shortage of resources, and so forth. Many issues of water scarcity, soil degradation, and unsustainable land use increasingly deteriorate these problems, seriously threatening agricultural production, freshwater reserves, and eco-stability. CRM utilizes unsupervised algorithms (Kmeans, DBScan, and Agglomerative Clustering) and supervised algorithms (Random Forest and XGBoost) for feature engineering based on target availability. Many insights and critical patterns are recognized through dimensionality reduction by Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and feature engineering. The Deep Learning-based algorithms, including the MLP, CNN, and RNN, are designed to predict risk while classifying the related risk levels into High, Moderate, and Low. According to the experimental analysis, the accuracy of the models applied is as follows: Random Forest (96.09%), MLP (92.96%), Logistic Regression (92.18%), SVM (91.40%), CNN (89.84%), KNN (80.46%), and RNN (62.50%). By providing user-interactive input features and map visualizations for risk predictions, our dashboard helps stakeholders find possible steps to identify and help develop potential strategies for forestation, retrieving soil loss, and sustainable water management systems. T The tool facilitates the analysis of indicators of risk to the environment using data that can help with sustainability-related decision-making in accordance with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
